verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general card management (active/inactive status), policy workflows, and MCP queries about flagged/violating transactions, but nothing documents configurable restrictions by category, merchant, or amount, nor automatic point-of-sale locking/declining of out-of-policy spend. missing for 10: explicit documentation of category/merchant/amount-based card controls, missing for 10: evidence of real-time auto-lock or point-of-sale decline enforcement.
